description:
First, click on our profile and see over 600 reviews of my work.

Absolutely impossible to be in London and not have good photos with at least 3 very landmarks: Big Ben, London Eye and the famous red phone booths. So we created an experience that will make you have the best memories with these three icons from London.

We will take a small group walk around the Big Ben area where we will also have a great view of the London Eye. During this hike, we'll stop in some strategic locations to take photos.

In this experience each person will be able to choose 5 photos, but you can buy extra photos if you want.

It's important to remember that it's a shared experience, and you may have more people at the same time as you. If you'd like a private photoshoot, please let us know.
locationDescription: We will take a small group walk around the Big Ben area where we also have a beautiful view of the London Eye. During this walk we will stop at some strategic locations to take the amazing photos!

reviews.text: What an incredible photoshoot. Pri selected beautiful locations and is a very talented photographer. My fiance and I got the perfect romantic pictures 😍👌🏼 Pri is also very nice and made us feel very relaxed and comfortable throughout the entire shoot. 10/10 would recommend.
I don't know if it gives classes in hogwarts but their photos are magical, it makes you look like a whole 10/10 model
It was really nice to take the photos, if you're traveling and want to remember I can definitely say it's worth it.
I had photos done with Pri in London and I absolutely love them. Her and Filipe were so lovely and friendly. If you have a chance to get photos done with them I 100% recommend.

I really enjoyed working with Pri and Felipe! They were friendly to work with. I enjoyed the locations we used for the photos and the photos came out beautiful. Photoshoots aren't easy for "normal" people so I appreciated the direction of poses throughout the time. It was a nice treat for my birthday and would recommend them for any occasion.

Pri is such a talented photographer.This is my second time with her.First in Paris so I trust her and book this session in London again. Her photos are so amazing and you can get all photos so quickly within 5 days. Pri and her husband make all the customers feel relaxed in front of the camera. Even this photo shooting is a group session(up to 10 people) but it’s good that you can make new friends in the group.

Pri and Felipe are warm and friendly. Pri shows you photos as she takes them so you can let her know if you want something different. The whole shoot took about 2 hours though only part of the time is for your photos. Keep in mind that this is a group experience but they really try to keep things moving along. Great first day in London; Pri and Felipe even provided some great playground recommendations for our family

Pri was great and so friendly! We had a toddler with us, and she and Felipe (her partner) kept things calm, fun, and efficient.

Most importantly, she takes great pictures.
Great experience. They are very nice people, patient and fun. This is my first time doing a photoshoot and it ended up being a lot of fun. I would definitely do it again.

The experience with Pri was so fun and she’s very easy to get along with. She knows how to direct and take amazing photos. It was indeed a fun shoot and it was so worth it! The locations and the spots where she took us are in the tourist areas with great backdrop of London but the angles of the images are she took of me are not your average tourist photos. I had a great time shooting with Pri. Well recommended!

This session was so much fun with Pri and Filipe. Pri takes absolutely wonderful pictures. We were in a group with another couple and individual and Filipe was so fun to talk to while we were waiting to get our pictures taken. You cant beat the valueof these pictures, they're in beautiful locations by a professional photographer. Would HIGHLY recommend this experience in whatever city the couple is offering it!

This is a must-do for your trip to London. We were both a bit nervous about looking silly during the shoot but Pri immediately put us at ease and made taking these lovely photos so simple and fun. Filipe was also very kind and welcoming and the two of them made this an unforgettable experience. I can’t wait to see the photos when they’re ready!

Wow! Just wow! The locations were beautiful, not crowded and a quick walk from each other. Pri and her husband were amazing with my children. They even put my oldest on their shoulders to walk to one of the locations. The pictures are stunning but the experience and the lack of stress that it took to get the pictures, is something I’m forever grateful for!

This was truly one of the best experiences I've ever had. I did a shoot with my partner, and it was so touching how Pri was able to beautifully and thoughtfully capture our essence and our love for each other. Apart from that, Pri is dope af, so creative, so nice, so funny, and a great time. This was my second time shooting w/ Pri (the first time was in Paris), and I'm for sure going to hit up Pri whenever we're in the same place to shoot. Thanks for everything!
🏼 Pri and Philipe are very attentive and professional, they adapted to what everyone wanted to show in their photos was incredible !!
This is a must have experience for those who travel alone, like me. Pri and Fe are super nice and easygoing. While Fe helped me out holding my stuff, Pri made the photoshooting really fun and easy.
What a fantastic experience! Pri is so kind and an amazingly skilled photographer. If you want a fun and easygoing experience with beautiful photo results, this is the experience for you.

One of my best experience in London! My husband and I are not very good at posing but we didn't have to be worried. Pri guided us how to make nice pose. I had another couple (Mom and daughter) in my time slot but didn't feel uncomfortable. My husband also liked this experience and said it is time and price-worthy even though he used to dislike to be taken pictures. Highly recommend to travelers to record beautiful moment in London.
Pri and her husband were very good at putting us at ease with the whole process. My first time having a professional photographer during a holiday trip and it went better than expected. Thanks!
Lovely experience! Hosts did a great job with arrival instructions and moving the experience along. Nice chat, great photos! Felipe made some suggestions on the location to explore close by.

The host Pri and Philipe are amazing people. Pri made sure we were comfortable while clicking pictures. It was nice meeting the other people on the experience too. Overall, it was an amazing experience.
Me and my love the experience, Pri is very friendly, she helped us make beautiful poses and the pictures look amazing.

This was a nice experience and a great way to meet new people. It was a friendly group and I'm so happy I decided to join last minute on my first day here. Pri was very helpful and gave specific poses, and chose good spots for touristy photos. We did not go to non touristy places, but Felipe pointed us in the direction to some graffiti tunnels that were interesting to see. We will all receive our photos in a few days and get to choose 5 then pay for any extra that want. Pri shows you the photos every time after she takes them to make sure you are satisfied.
Overall a great experience that I would recommend to others, especially solo travelers.

I’m a solo traveler so it’s always hard to get great photos. I loved how they turned out. They gave you quick look at your photos before moving on to the next guest incase you wanted to reshoot. I just received the photos and I’m looking forward to the finished product. Pri and partner were super relaxed and made me feel welcomed. It was nice to get to know them and the other guests as well.

I had an amazing experience with Pri and Felipe with the photoshoot session. They are very professional and welcoming, made me feel comfortable and gave tips during the session so the photos would look really great.

The shared experience gives great value for money as private photoshoot sessions can be quite pricey.

I'm looking forward to receiving my photos but I'm already very happy with what I've seen during the session (Pri shows all the photos as she takes them).

This was an awesome experience. Pri & Filipe were very nice and friendly. I rarely take pictures but Pri made this so comfortable and seamless. On top of this, I missed my appointment but she scheduled me for the next day without me asking. Thank you!

My wife and I had a wonderful time having our pictures taken by Pri! She was super friendly and talented (as was her husband). She was also incredibly good at capturing special moments, beautiful surroundings/architecture, and the perfect lighting. I highly recommend you get your pictures taken here! Thank you Pri and Filipe!
The experience was amazing and the photos were wonderful! Pri and Felipe are super friendly people who go above and beyond to make us comfortable in the pictures. Great value.

Pri and Filipe are super friendly, sweet and very professional with their photos and tips for posing. I was more than 10 mins late since the route to meet up was a little confusing but they were very accommodating and even made up the lost time for me. I haven’t received the end results yet but I’m really looking forward to receiving the pictures in ~5 days!
Great experience. Priscila knows how to relax us, and do a good job. For those looking to have a top photo of good location and quality, I recommend it.
Pri is so friendly and professional photographer! I enjoyed spending time with them as well ! Magical, beautiful experience! I highly recommend this experience 😃

5 out of 5. Great experience! Pri and Felipe are super professional and friendly. They made us feel very comfortable from the very beginning and gave us ton of tips on poses and photography in general. You can tell they are passionate about what they are doing and that is reflected in the amazing pictures we received. Definitely recommend!

Pri and Felipe are super thoughtful. On the day of our experience, there was a manifestation happening close to the site, and they were very sacred offering different leases and even extended the duration, not allowing it to affect the experience. Pri is an exceptionally talented photographer, the photos look great. I recommend it.
Amazing experience with Pri!! I know how to guide me for the photo shoot! Now let's wait for the final result! Both very friendly!

This is a great experience for making lasting memories, especially when travelling solo. The usual tourist just takes pictures of places and not so much of themselves in these places. Pri really knows how take great pictures and gives you helpful instructions. Also, I loved how we did not have to walk for miles as all the sights were nearby. I cannot wait to see the results! Thank you!
Pri and Filipe took great photos of my husband and I. She managed to capture the moment beautifully. Book them if you’re looking for an affordable photoshoot!

It is very quick and memorable experienced. They are so approachable couples and lovely too! Easy to get along with and they love what they do! Not only for earning money but making sure the customers will have a nice pic!

Pri and Filipe is very professional and friendly. They really know what to do and how to put on your best poses and shots even though you don’t how to post just leave it so they can handle professionally.

We were wondering about this experience, but it was certainly the best idea for everyone. We are shy, but Pri and Filipe made us feel very comfortable taking photos, helping with the poses! We recommend this experience to any couple in London, as it was a photoshoot that timed our moments there. They thought of every detail, we think it's genius! The pictures are really professional, my wife and I really enjoyed it! It was really fun and they were really thoughtful! Thank you sincerely Pri and Filipe! There are 10 of you!

That experience was awesome! Priscila is a professional photographer that makes any person a model. Besides, the location is in the heart of London and I'll have photos of all the main British spots to remember this amazing trip. I recommend it for all people even the shyest.

We had a great experience with Pri and Filipe. In addition to beautiful photos they are very friendly people, we have fun. Pri made us feel comfortable and we loved the photos. Our best memory of London!

The experience was great. The pictures are beautiful and Pri knows exactly what to do. She helps us with good tips and makes us feel good all the time. It was very fast and very nice, everything my husband and I needed for our London trip to be unforgettable. If you come to London be sure to take pictures with her!!!

I loved my experience with Pri and Filipe. They were fun and made me feel very comfortable for the photos, it looked so much better than I imagined. I will never forget this fun time in London, the best part of my trip. The photos are beautiful but the best thing is the experience. If you're going to London and are lucky enough to have their schedule available, enjoy it, you'll love it!

Pri is amazing and patient! For those who are embarrassed, it was very easy to let go. She already knows the best positions, angles, and locations. I loved it! It's so worth having wonderful photos of London!

Pri was an amazing photographer and such a kind soul! She and her husband created a very relaxed atmosphere for myself and the group! Would highly recommend her for any type of photography! She knew great spots for all the typical London locations and I was able to get awesome pictures! A super deal for a college budget. I made an unexpected friend, would definitely recommend!

Loved our experience..Great value for the money. Pri and her husband are very nice, an adventurous couple. Thanks to our experience I'm going to take to Brazil a little bit of London ... highly recommend it!
This experience was definitely the “cherry” on the cake of our trip in London. Pri was very attentive, patient and took photos that we will keep forever. I would highly recommend it!!

Pri and Filipe are a lovely couple. They were extremely thoughtful!!! London is a beautiful city and well worth having professional photos, especially with them that they were amazing. We were lucky enough to be just me and my husband in our schedule, and we got their attention all to us. Plus they were super fast and sent us the photos in the same day. Would do again for sure.
